subject: ss-rheumatology-immunology
title: Rheumatic manifestations of malignancy and checkpoint inhibitors

steps.tx: Paraneoplastic rheumatic syndromes can unmask an **occult malignancy**, sometimes months before the tumour becomes clinically obvious. Consider them when an older adult develops sudden, symmetric **small joint synovitis** with **pitting oedema** over the dorsum of the hands, especially with negative rheumatoid serology. Rapid improvement with **low-dose oral corticosteroids** is common, but that benefit should never be taken as reassurance. Full, age-appropriate cancer screening remains essential.

nodes.label: Older adult with sudden symmetric hand synovitis
Assess for pitting oedema and exclude other causes

steps.tx: **Hypertrophic osteoarthropathy (HOA)** combines digital clubbing, arthralgia and periostitis. Primary HOA is inherited, often with **HPGD** mutations that reduce prostaglandin breakdown, and it usually settles after adolescence. Secondary HOA is most often linked to **non-small cell lung carcinoma**, so a malignancy search is mandatory in any adult case.

steps.tx: Clubbing is confirmed on examination. The **Lovibond sign** is positive when the angle between the proximal nail fold and the nail exceeds 180 degrees. The **Schamroth sign** is lost when the diamond-shaped window between opposed terminal phalanges disappears. A distal to interphalangeal depth ratio above 1 supports clubbing on measurement.

steps.tx: The **VEGF** pathway drives the bone changes. Raised **PGE2** induces VEGF expression in osteoblasts and joint tissue, promoting angiogenesis, increased vascular permeability and osteoblast migration. This explains periosteal new bone formation and soft tissue edema. Serum VEGF is raised in both primary and secondary forms.

steps.tx: **Technetium 99m MDP bone scintigraphy** is the most sensitive test for skeletal HOA and can show the **tramline sign**, a symmetric tracer uptake along the cortical margins of long bones. Synovial fluid is pauci-inflammatory, usually under 500 white cells per microlitre, which helps separate it from inflammatory arthritis. Chest imaging is needed in any adult with clinical HOA.

steps.tx: **Cancer-associated myositis** and **immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)** toxicity are important modern mimics. ICI arthritis and myositis can occur with PD-1 or PD-L1 blockade, and ICI myositis can overlap with **myocarditis**, which carries high mortality. Evaluate for raised troponin and creatine kinase, and treat with high-dose steroids while holding the drug if severe. Indian guidance on immunotherapy toxicity should be followed locally.
